10000101: "Welcome to the world of Ragnarok Online 2! We here at the Kafra Corporation have done our best to put together this guide for all of the adventurers in Rune-Midgarts, to ensure that no one ever gets lost or confused while traveling through the world!"
10000102: "If you're new to adventuring, you should definitely take a look through the Guide, even if a lot of it seems unfamiliar or complicated right now. You'll get there, we promise! And if you're a veteran adventurer, you may still want to take a look through the Guide. Maybe you'll find something out about the world that you never knew before!"
10000104:
"P.S. The Kafra Corporation is always open to suggestions on how to better improve the Guide, so if you have a suggestion, feel free to contact one of the fine GMs throughout the world, and they may just pass your suggestion along!

Signed,
~-~ The Kafra Corporation"
10000201: Freyja and the Day of Despair
10000202: "Freyja was once a beautiful and merciful goddess who loved life. But after her husband Odin's betrayal, she was banished from the realm of the gods, Asgard. With this act, she transformed into a goddess of destruction, swearing revenge against Odin and all of his creations - including Midgard."
10000203: "The day of Freyja's ultimate revenge is known as the ""Day of Despair."" Freyja and her 12 Valkyries started a cataclysm of Water and Fire, destroying much of the world.  In the last days before the Midgard continent was destroyed, brave young heroes stood up to save the world.\nAmong the heroes was the reincarnation of Baldur, a youth named Chaos. Chaos gathered allies through various adventures, and with their help, succeeded in locking up the goddess Freyja on another world, Vanaheim."
10000204: "Starting life anew after the Day of Despair, the people moved on to found a new Kingdom called Rune-Midgarts, under the rule of Sir Pior, after the successor, Tristan Gaebolg , went missing in action during the Day of Despair, crumbling the Gaebolg monarchy."
10000205: "King Pior's rule was not to last as he was soon dethroned by riotous refugees agitated by the kingdom's economic affairs, abolishing traditional monarchy and establishing the Republic of Midgarts, under President Witold Schurt's rule."
10000206: "War returned to the Republic of Midgarts, with the rediscovery of the Svartalf continent. The Republic of Midgarts lost their independence as a result of the war, and became a vassal state of the Svartalf continent. Twenty years later, an independence movement rose up throughout the Midgard continent, led by Ignatz Gaebolg, who claimed to be a descendant of Tristan Gaebolg, the king who had led the Kingdom of Rune-Midgarts to great prosperity in the past. Ignatz was successful in gaining popular support for his legitimacy and eventually won independence for the Midgard continent. He then set about to establish a new Kingdom of Rune-Midgarts, becoming the first king of the new kingdom. Time passed, the world was eventually restored to peace, and the Day of Despair and Freyja became legend."
10000207: The Ashkaron Empire and the Dimensional Crevice
10000208: "Beyond Mt. Mjolnir, north of the capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, Prontera, Lord Siegfried established the Ashkaron Empire. As a descendent of Sage Sigmund, the founder of the magical city of Geffen in the ancient Rune-Midgarts kingdom, Lord Siegfried was expected to continue the tradition of magical study, but he was far more interested in science and the natural forces than in magic. Because of this, magical scholars from across Rune-Midgarts banded together and forced him out of the kingdom. Many citizens and scientists that praised then-Lord Siegfried's leadership and influence followed him on his travels to a new continent."
10000209: "After reaching the new continent, they soon encountered Saryong Jormugand’s brother, the black dragon Ashkaron. Lord Siegfried used the Holy Balmung blade, which had been passed down in his family for generations, to defeat Ashkaron and establish the Ashkaron Empire. But the black dragon Ashkaron laid a curse of drought across the continent as he died, and only Lord Siegfried’s research has been able to keep his followers alive in the barren environment. This deep interest in science has led to the rapid expansion of civilization across the continent, with the Askharon Empire eventually becoming the strongest of all continents."
10000210: "One day near the outskirts of the Empire, a Dimensional Crevice appeared. It was small at first, no larger than the palm of a hand, but it grew over time to be larger than the largest castle on the continent. Numerous demons emerged from the Dimensional Crevice as it grew, beginning a brutal war against Ashkaron."
10000211: "The strongest of the twelve Valkyrie, Valkyrie Reginleif, was sealed in Vanaheim with Freyja, but not before her appearance led to the fall of the Ashkaron Empire. Demons now rampage across the Ashkaron continent, with the remaining survivors continuing to fight for their homes. The fall of the Ashkaron Empire led to great turmoil in the nearby Rune-Midgarts kingdom. After great effort, the Kingdom’s magicians were able to seal the Dimensional Crevice, and the Kingdom created a special investigation team to continue researching how the Dimensional Crevice came about – and to find ways to prevent another from forming."
10000213: "Ten years ago, members of an unknown group began kidnapping children from all across the continent. After a thorough investigation by the Knights of Prontera, the High Knight Wilfred Barclay led his men in an attack on the base in order to retrieve the kidnapped children. When they arrived, they discovered a laboratory filled with unknown experimental tools that had been used on the children. "
10000214: "After intense fighting, the Knights were able to defeat the kidnappers and rescue the missing children, but with most of the children now orphans without homes, the senior Knights who took part in the operation volunteered to take care of the rescued children. During the situation, a senior Knight named Zeras Hyperion, distinguished himself and eventually took over for Wilfred Barclay as the head of the Knights of Prontera after Barclay chose to retire."
10000216: "In order to better understand the movements of the demons beyond the mountains, King Eckhard traveled beyond Mt. Mjolnir with the Royal Guard and the Knights of Prontera. To ensure he would be able to defend himself, he bore the Holy Sword Balmung that slew the great dragon Jormungand. During his expedition, however, the King disappeared."
10000217: "The King’s disappearance, not to mention the Holy Sword Balmung, caused a ripple effect throughout the kingdom. Queen Kamil, who had the right to thake the throne for herself, tried to calm the public by crowning King Eckhard’s brother, Reinhard Gaebolg, as king. Reinhard Gaebolg was successful in stabilizing the royal family and repairing the public’s confidence through the advice of the Queen and the superior force of his own power."
10000218: "Shortly after the coronation of Reinhard Gaebolg, the chief of the Royal Guard tasked with protecting King Eckhard, Sir Kirk Graham, committed suicide. While investigating, it was discovered that Sir Graham was behind the disappearance of the king, and that his was the hand that assassinated the king."
10000220: "Over the past few years, rumors of a new religious group called the Freyjanity have begun to spread. Claiming to be the descendants of the Church-Nation Arunafeltz, they praise the goddess Freyja and await her return. Their fanatical devotion to Freyja led to suspicion from most, but the Kingdom did not feel they were a militant threat, so generally ignored them. Around the same time that these rumors began, reports began trickling in about a surge in Dimensional Cracks, smaller areas where strange energies and creatures were able to cross the threshold and enter Midgard."
10000221: "While not as big as the Dimensional Crevice, these Cracks were still large enough to let smaller creatures through to threaten the populace. Because of this, the Kingdom had no choice but to post recruitment notices all over Midgard to take care of this strange new presence. Adventurers from all over the land began to gather in Prontera, developing skills and building motivation to keep Midgard safe from this new threat."
10000301: "Welcome to the Kafra Corporation’s Adventurer Guide! On behalf of everyone here, we’d like to thank you for spending your time with us here in Rune-Midgarts!\n\nThis Guide has been put together to answer many of the questions that new adventurers may have about Rune-Midgarts and the world of Ragnarok Online 2, and maybe even clarify things that veteran adventurers have been confused about. We will continue to update this with new information as our team of Kafra Researchers completes their research."
10000303: "Topics in the Guide have been divided into a number of main categories on the right side, each with a list of subcategories to choose from. Selecting a main category like Getting Started will display a dropdown with additional options. Choosing one of those will display information about the selected topic. Simple, isn’t it?"
10000305: "Some of these subcategories have also been divided further into subtopics, because of the wealth of information available. For example, the Crafting & Upgrades categories have a number of these subtopics to narrow down the type of Crafting by Job. Those can be selected at the top of the Guide in the Title bar."
11000101: This is the standard user interface displayed when entering into Ragnarok Online 2:
11000103:
"This is you! More specifically, this is the avatar that represents you in the world of Ragnarok Online 2. You will always appear in the center of the camera, so don’t worry about getting lost!
Hotbar / Player Status / Inventory
Player Detailed Status & Menu
Target Pane
Minimap
Chat Window
Notifications Area
System Messages & Tips"
11000105: "This is the Hotbar, Player Status, and Inventory area. Important actions like attacks and potions are placed here, and the Porings on each side show how your HP and SP are doing at a glance. This area also displays your experience level, a count of your currencies, and your Inventory bags."
11000106:
1: Hotbar




2: HP Poring



3: SP Poring



4: Class & Job XP




5: Inventory & Currency











6: Guardian Gauge
11000107:
"The Hotbar is one of the most direct ways to interact with the world. Combat skills can be added to the Hotbar for use in battle, and items such as potions and scrolls may be added as well. You can also add Social actions and Emoticons to the Hotbar!

The HP Poring gives you a visual representation of your health. If the Poring is smiling, you're healthy! If it looks sad, you're not doing so well! If it winces, you were just hit!

The SP Poring gives you a visual representation of your Spell/Stamina Points. If the Poring is smiling, you're doing great! If it looks sad, you're running low! If it winces, you were just hit!

The two bars at the bottom show your current Experience Points earned toward your next Class or Job level. At the far right of each bar, the number displayed is your current Class (top) or Job (bottom) level.

Inventory in Ragnarok Online 2 is displayed via the Bags you carry. Players start with a Basic Bag, which holds up to 20 items, and a range of additional Bags can be found or purchased during your travels! Click each bag to open bags individually, or press the assigned hotkey (default: B) to open them all.
Purchasing items and services in Rune-Midgarts requires Currency, which is shown below the Bag icons. The gold coins are Zeny, the silver coins are Rupees, and the diamonds are Diamonds. 1 Zeny is equal to 1000 Rupees, and Diamonds are a special currency that can be earned in game or purchased through the Kafra Shop.

The Guardian Gauge tracks when you can summon your Guardian Spirit. Each Job has an associated Guardian Spirit, and upon reaching Job Level 10 and completing a quest, this summon becomes available."
11000109: "This is the Player Detailed Status and Menu area. The Player Detailed Status shows your name and class, as well as any active status effects that have been applied to your character."
11000111: "This area displays (from left to right) your character's Class icon, current level, character name, and both the visual and numerical display of your character's Health and SP"
11000113: "The Menu dropdown gives a full list of all of the various windows accessible within the UI. These windows can be accessed either through this Menu, or through an associated Hotkey."
11000115: "This is the Target Pane, which shows detailed information about whatever you may have selected. This area can also show a “Target of Target” pane as well, which shows whatever your Target happens to be focused on."
11000116:
1: Current Target Pane




2: Target of Target
11000117: "Like the Player Detailed Status, this area displays an image of the target, the distance to the target, the target’s level, their name, and both a visual and numerical display of the target’s Health and SP.\n\nThis holds the same information as the Target Pane, but only appears if your Target also has a target! This is great to use if you're adventuring in a group, to know just which of your friends a monster is about to attack."
11000119: "This is the Minimap area, which has a lot more information than just the Minimap! This corner also opens the World Map, shows which game channel you’re in, and also allows access to the Kafra Item Shop!"
11000121: The Minimap provides an overhead view of the world as you travel through it. Icons that appear on the Minimap indicate everything from Friends and Enemies to Quest NPCs and Merchants! The full list of icons can be viewed as an extension of the Map (default: M) by opening the panel on the right. The Minimap can also be zoomed in and out using the (-) and (+) icons in the top corners.
11000123: "The upper area of the Minimap provides multiple pieces of important information. At the very top, it lists the area you're currently in, which is useful if you're trying to meet up with friends! In the top right, a button allows you to open the World Map directly, though you can also use the default Hotkey (M). Below the title, the current time is displayed."
11000125: "This opens the Dungeon Lockout screen, which allows you to reset dungeon instances that you have previously entered!"
11000127: "This opens up the Threat Meter window, showing the Threat that each player has generated for your target. Enemies will generally target the player with the highest Threat rating."
11000129: "This area displays your current Channel, and provides a button to display the Channel List. This list shows all of the current Channels, as well as their player load, to allow you to switch between Channels to join an adventure with your friends!"
11000131: "The Phantom Pyramid is a mysterious Pyramid that players can explore and earn prizes! Using Phantom Stones (earned as rewards or purchasable from the Kafra Shop), you can advance to higher and higher levels of the Pyramid to earn better rewards. To begin using the Phantom Pyramid, you must use a Phantom Stone. If your progress stops on an item, you can either collect it or try for an item on a higher tier. Landing on a Mystical or Bright Phantom Stone will stop all progress on the Pyramid. If you collect enough Mystical or Bright Phantom Stones, you can instantly access the middle and highest levels of the Pyramid, respectively.\nThe Kafra Shop allows you direct access to all of the great items created and sold by the Kafra Corporation! While Kafra Vendors throughout the land will take Zeny in trade for items, items in the Kafra Shop require Kafra Points to purchase. Take a look at the Kafra Shop section of this guide for further details about the Kafra Shop, and how to purchase Kafra Points!"
11000133: "As you adventure through Rune-Midgarts, you may notice a popup on your screen, alerting you to a Present Box! We here at the Kafra Corporation send out a Present Box holding a Leprechaun Cube to adventurers after they have spent 10, 30, 60, and 120 minutes traveling in the world! Please note that you must claim your Present Box before the countdown timer will display the next timer, and the timer is shared across all characters on your Account."
11000135: "This is the Chat window, and is the main way to communicate with other players in the game."
11000137: "This area contains many of the mechanics for the Chat Window. On the far left is the ""Grab"" marker, to allow you to move the Chat Window to your desired location. Across the top are the Chatroom Listings, with the default channels displayed: All, Chat, Combat, and System. Each of these can be customized by Right-clicking and opening the Custom Options menu, which allows you to set custom names for Chatrooms, filter what chat channels should be displayed in a chatroom, and to set custom colors for each channel."
11000139: "These buttons provide Quick Navigation for a variety of features for Chat. The (?) is actually a hover-over help tooltip which displays a list of commonly used chat commands. The Channel button opens the Conversation panel to the 'Channel' tab, allowing you to customize user-created channels, set passwords, invite others, and see who is online in a user channel. The next button allows you to create a public or private chat room, set a password, and limit the number of players allowed. Next, a button that changes the Vertical Size of the chat with each click. Finally, the Chat Window Default Settings window, which allows you to customize the appearance of the Chat Window as a whole - including colors, transparency, and font size. Make the Chat Window your own!"
11000141: "This is where the chat discussion appears, and different channels will display different discussions depending on your Chat Settings."
11000143: "This area is where you actually chat with your friends and other adventurers! The arrow on the left provides a list of chat functions (matching the Help tooltip) that can auto-populate in the text entry area. Next to that is a display that show which channel you're currently typing into, and the rest of the area is where you type!"
11000145: "This is the Notifications area. Whenever you get a mail message, or receive a gift, or earn talent points to spend, a Notification will appear here as a reminder. You can change which of these appear in the Game Options menu (default: Esc) under Game Settings."
11000147: "This is the System Message and Tip area. By default, tips will display here and give you advice on how to perform a variety of actions throughout Ragnarok Online 2. Additionally, server messages announcing important events such as maintenance times, world boss spawns, or WoE announcements, will display here. The System Messages will always display as needed, but the Tooltips can be deactivated in the Game Options menu (default: Esc) under Game Settings\Feature."
11000201: "The Inventory window contains all of the items that you carry with you on your travels, and is divided into separate Bags. Each Bag can hold a different number of items, from the 5-slot Supersmall Bag to the 35-slot Ultrasuperlarge Bag. To start on your travels, the Kafra Corporation provides each adventurer with what they call a ""Basic Bag"". This Bag holds up to 20 items, and will be with you throughout your journey."
11000203: "Displays the type of bag that is equipped in a particular Bag Slot. This makes it easy to tell which type of bags you currently have, to allow you upgrade the correct ones!"
11000205: Displays the Bag Slot Number that the current Bag occupies.
11000207: "Displays what is carried inside the Bag. Each slot within the bag can hold 1 item icon, though many items can stack together to save space!"
11000209: "Condenses all items across all of your bags to take up the smallest amount of space possible. This will combine all items that can be stacked, and move them into the lowest Bag Slot available."
11000211: "Allows you to store Cards that you have acquired in a single album, keeping them neatly organized and preventing them from taking up valuable Inventory space. Card Albums can be purchased from the Kafra Shop, and are often given out to starting adventurers to assist them in their early travels."
11000301: "The Character Window shows all of the vital characteristics of your character, and is broken into 3 major areas:"
11000304: "The Player Information area, at the top of the Character Window, displays the level of both your Class and Job, as well as what Union and Guild you’re allied with. Additionally, it also shows what your Kafra Save Point is set to! Set it nearby, or else you’re in for a hike!"
11000306: "The Equipment Information area is the area that you’ll have the most direct interaction with. Divided into 4 separate tabs, shown below, this area is where you can view and change all of your equipped items, costumes, and cards. An additional panel displays a listing of your current Player-versus-Player (PvP) statistics - Knight Points earned, your current rank, total kill counts, etc…"
11000307: "Equipment can come in various rarities. Increasing rarity denotes greater power, and an increased capacity for additional stats and upgrades. A total of 13 different slots are available for equipment, including weapons, multiple types of armor, and a variety of accessories!"
11000312:
"Equipment can be purchased from merchants, crafted by Blacksmiths and Artisans, or dropped by monsters.

Before making a purchase, be sure to check the item requirements. These may include class, level, or even rank requirements. Some equipment can be used by everyone, some can only be used by a Class ‘family’ (i.e. Swordsman, Knight, Warrior), and some are Class-specific. Be sure you’re buying the items that you can use!

All Weapons and Armor have durability, which can be lost through battle or after taking a fatal strike. Always be vigilant and keep your equipment well maintained. When durability reaches zero, you will lose any stat bonuses that piece of equipment normally provides until it is repaired. "
11000314: "Costumes are a fun way to change your character’s appearance without having to remove your equipment! Costumes can be easily toggled on and off with the checkboxes next to each slot, so you can turn them on and off to show your friends!\n\nCostumes can occupy one or more slots on the Costume Window - some Costumes will even cover your entire body! Mix and match them to make the coolest outfit you can!"
11000316: "The Cards tab shows which Cards are currently equipped, as well as how many Card Slots are available for your character. All adventurers begin with 1 slot open, and unlock an additional slot every 10 levels (up to level 40).\n\nHovering over the Cards you have equipped will display what bonuses they are providing you, and will also show whether their Set Bonus is active. Finding Card Sets gives you extra bonuses, so do your best and find those Cards!"
11000318: "The PvP Stats tab displays everything recorded about your PvP experience. Wins in PvP activities will earn Knight Points, and earning more Knight Points will increase your Knight Class Rank. Sixteen different Ranks can be earned through PvP activities (listed below) which can be displayed as your character’s Title, and the Knight Points you earn can be exchanged at certain vendors for great items and consumables!"

11000323: "The Stats side of the Character Window is one you’ll want to pay extra close attention to. This area shows you just how effective you are in combat, and allows you to add points directly to some of your stats to make yourself stronger! With the variety of stats in the land of Rune-Midgarts, it’s sometimes difficult to keep all of the numbers straight. That’s why we’ve done it for you right here!\n\nStats can be divided into two categories, known as ‘Base Stats’ and ‘Secondary Stats’."
11000325: "Base Stats are the group of 5 stats that you can directly add points to, in order to increase their value. The amount that each Secondary Stat will increase is class-dependent, so some stats become far more valuable for certain classes than others. These stats are:"
11000327:
"Strength is a measure of your character’s physical prowess. Increasing your STR stat may improve your Attack Power, Parry, and Accuracy.
Agility is a measure of your character’s dexterity and flexibility. Increasing your AGI stat may improve your Accuracy, Critical Hit Rate, and Dodge.
Intelligence is a measure of your character’s magical ability. Increasing your INT stat may improve Magical Attack Power, Parry, and Accuracy.
Wisdom is a measure of your character’s mental fortitude. Increasing your WIS stat improves your SP and SP Recovery from potions.
Vitality is a measure of your character’s physical health. Increasing your VIT stat improves your HP, HP Recovery from potions, and Defense."
11000329: "Secondary Stats are additional stats that are created from a combination of base stats, your class, and your level, all mixed together in various formulas to achieve the result. While these secondary stats can’t be directly increased like base stats can, increasing your base stats will show a change in some of your Secondary Stats. Additionally, different kinds of equipment may have an impact on Secondary Stats, such as weapons increasing your Attack Power. Secondary stats are:"

11000331:
"Health Points, or HP, represent how much health your character has. When this value hits 0, you’ll die, so make sure to keep this high! HP does recover naturally over time, but it is a slow process. Red health potions will refill your HP much faster, and are easy to find or craft.

Spell/Stamina Points, also known as mana or SP, represent how much innate power you have to cast spells and use abilities. Some classes have less demands on their SP than others, so be careful about running out of SP in the middle of a fight! SP will recovery naturally over time, but Blue SP potions will refill this in a pinch!

This represents your physical attack ability, and is raised by equipping weapons. Weapon types differ in the Attack Power they provide, as many of them will have an impact on other stats as well.

This represents your magical attack ability, and is much the same as Attack Power… except for magic!

Cast Speed determines how quickly you can cast a skill that has a casting time. This doesn’t increase the speed of the skill itself once cast, but does mean that you’ll spend less time casting.

Haste improves your Attack Speed, which is the rate of your character’s basic attacks.

Vigor reduces the cooldown on most skills and items, making it a very valuable stat to increase.

Also known as Accuracy, the Hit Rate determines how often your skills and attacks will successfully land on your target. It is opposed by your opponent’s Dodge rating.

This determines the likelihood for an attack or skill to land a Critical Hit, adding extra damage to the attack. It is opposed by your opponent’s Parry rating.

Penetration represents your ability to ignore an opponent’s Defense value. A higher Penetration means that your attacks can bypass more of their armor!

As the name suggests, this stat directly impacts your ability to cause damage to other players in PvP settings. This is opposed by the Damage Reduction (PvP) stat.

Defense represents your ability to reduce incoming damage, and is improved by equipping armor.

Your Dodge rating represents your ability to avoid your opponent’s attacks, causing them to miss you entirely. This is opposed by your opponent’s Hit Rate.

Your Parry rating determines the likelihood of reducing the damage of an incoming attack by half. It also allows you to turn a Critical Hit into a normal hit if the attack is successfully Parried.

As the name suggests, this stat allows you to reduce incoming damage from other players in PvP settings. This stat directly opposes the damage increase from the Damage Increase (PvP) stat."
11000401: "The Quest Journal (Default: L) provides vital information about the various adventures you’ll experience in Rune-Midgarts! The Quest Journal can be displayed in two different forms, shown below."
11000402: The Quest Journal (above) and Quest Tracker (right)
11000403: "The Quest Journal book provides information about the quests that you have chosen to accept. The left side of the Journal will display the quest’s location, the title and level of the quest, and allow you to track the Quest in the Quest Tracker window. The right side of the Journal will show additional details about a selected quest, along with showing any rewards you may receive!"
11000404: "The Quest Tracker is a window that you’ll constantly have access to, which will display a list of any of the quests you have marked for tracking in the Quest Journal, as well as displaying your next objective on each quest. You can also click the “+” button next to each Quest title to display additional information. For additional help, you can click on a specific objective under a quest - this will open the map and display where to look! Now, this doesn’t work for every quest, but it may help you find an elusive creature or plant that you’re looking for."

13000101: "Quests are adventures!~\nWait, you probably want more than that, don’t you? Okay, here goes!"
13000102: "Quests are all of the different requests, tasks, and adventures you’ll experience throughout Rune-Midgarts. Many Quests will come directly from people asking you for help. Others you may choose to do to become more powerful in your Job, or to receive a brand new recipe! Others you may stumble across by accident. Some you’ll be able to do every day, and others are limited time quests. I’ve heard that some may come directly to your mailbox!"
13000103: "With all of these Quests available, you’re probably wondering about how to keep them all straight, and just exactly how Quests work. Well! Your Quest Journal and Tracker can document up to 20 Quests at a time, and a lot of Quests may take place in the same areas, so taking a bunch of Quests before you go out adventuring gives you the chance to complete a bunch of them before you return! As for the way Quests work, they can be broken into three distinct parts: the Bestowal, the Action, and the Completion."
13000104: "The Quest Bestowal is the point when you accept the quest. While exploring Rune-Midgarts, you may see the “!” symbol above NPCs or objects - by interacting with them, a Quest will be offered! By accepting the quest, all of the information about the quest will be copied into your Quest Journal and Quest Tracker, to remind you of all of the details of the quest and help guide you in the right direction."
13000105: "After accepting the quest, the Quest Tracker will update with the new Quest information, and will display the steps necessary to complete it. You’ll also see a new symbol above the head of the Quest Bestower. This shows that you’ve accepted their quest, and they’re awaiting your return! If you speak with them again, they'll be happy to remind you of any quest details you may have forgotten."
13000106: "As you complete the steps of the Quest, the Tracker and Journal will update, and a message will appear about your success! Some Quests may automatically grant you a reward, but most require you to return to an NPC to claim your Quest Reward."
13000201: "Dungeons are locations scattered throughout Rune-Midgarts that pose an extra challenge to adventurers, and are packed full of ruthless monsters to defeat. With extra difficulty, however, comes extra rewards!"
13000202: "The entrance to the Culvert, and the Dungeon Select window"
13000203: "Dungeons can be enjoyed by players of all levels, with two difficulties for each dungeon. Normal difficulty dungeons are a great way for lower level adventurers to find friends and share the fun! The Kafra Corporation suggests taking a group of 4 to 5 into a Normal dungeon, or else it may be too difficult to complete - and we’re here to help you succeed! Hard dungeons are much more difficult - adventurers must be level 50 before attempting, and should only enter with a full party of 5. Those creatures are dangerous, so be careful!"
13000301: "Events are special quest lines and activities that occur on a regular basis, like the Rune-Midgarts Anniversary event, or the Lunar Festival, or the Winter Nights and Yule Festivals! Events have a specific theme, depending on the time of year, and are a great time to explore around and see what’s new."
13000302: "Many events, like the Anniversary and the Winter Holiday events, will happen each year. Others may only happen once! Most of the Events held in Rune-Midgarts have a special title associated with the Event, which can provide great bonuses to those who wear it. So make sure you find the special Event NPCs for each Event, and do your best to earn all of the rewards! "
13000401: Each city offers a variety of different services to adventurers on their travels. These can be easily seen on the Map and Minimap as small icons - toggle them on and off from the Map’s Screen Display Icon extension on the right side!
13000403: "Merchants are often the first stop when you enter a city, either to sell some of your hard-won rewards or to purchase items and upgrades to make your next fights easier. From potions to weapons and armor, merchants sell a wide range of items! You can also just stop by and say hello!"
13000405: "For beginner adventurers, be sure to stop by the Mount Manager for your very first Peco Peco mount. For customers with more exotic friends, be sure to purchase some food in order to brighten up their day and allow them to activate their special boost skill."
13000407: "Safety first! Be sure to stop by the Repair Expert before you head out to battle. You can’t fight with a broken sword or block with broken armor, so be sure to keep yourself in tip-top shape!"
13000409: "Are you itching to get a shiny new set of armor? Purchase some magic stones to draw out the latent magic from your old gear to obtain crafting materials for your new gear. Reduce, reuse, recycle!"
13000411: Learn from the best of the best! Speak with Experts of your respective profession to learn new recipes and to purchase raw materials and ingredients for your latest creations.
13000413: Exchange messages and parcels with your friends no matter where they are! The mailbox is talking to you? Nonsense.
13000415: All for one and one for all! Band together with your allies to form and manage an alliance like no other.
13000417: Pay tribute to the achievements of your greatest peers and receive powerful blessings for your next journey.
13000419: It’s time to d-d-d-do things to your cards! Make your cards even stronger by utilizing Reinforcement and Card Combination.
13000421: "Exchange special statues obtained from completing quests for shiny new equipment. Meow, that’s right!"
13000423: "There’s a dog! A big bad dog! Or maybe not. Regardless, if you can prove your salt as a bounty hunter, be sure to take on these rewarding requests."
13000501: The Kafra Corporation is always ready to serve! The ladies of the Kafra Corporation can provide many services and have been stationed all over Rune-Midgarts for your convenience.
13000503: The Kafra Services shop sells many tools for your adventuring needs. Don’t leave home without a Butterfly wing!
13000505: Every customer has their own personal storage for safeguarding their most treasured items.
13000507: Home is where the heart is! Be sure to set your save point so you always have a place to put up your feet after a long journey.
13000509: Our most astute employees are always supporting the growth of our young adventurers. Be sure to listen to their words carefully as they guide you towards new challenges.
13000511: Use the Kafra Corporation Auction House to reach customers far and wide. Just leave your wares and let us handle the rest! Adventurers will be able to browse our entire catalogue of items and have their purchases delivered straight to their mailbox.
13000513: "Near, far, wherever you are! Our experienced flyers will help you swiftly traverse around Rune-Midgarts without encountering pesky monsters. "
13000515: Are you feeling lucky? Try your luck and compete for ownership of our beautiful guild houses. Access to this luxury location and its convenient services will be granted to all members of your guild for 4 weeks.
13000517: "Oh my, you look like you were run over by a herd of Potemkins. No worries, bring an Appearance Change Ticket to Kafra Surgeon and she’ll give you a face not even your mother would recognize!"
13000601: "With the Khara Quest System, you can find yourself straying far off the questing path to fulfill objectives. The world is full of challenges and the only way to discover them is to continue exploring! These side missions, when completed, will reward you with Khara titles that boost your character to greater heights!"
13000602: "When you first open your Khara Quest window, what appears before you is a vast, grayed out slate of quests. This is just the start of your side-quest journey! As you explore the world naturally, Khara Quests will begin unlocking for you to challenge!\n\nAs you complete Khara Quests, you’ll begin to earn Khara Points. These points can be spent to unlock additional challenges, often rewarding you with a Title that you can show off to your friends - plus, many of the titles grant bonuses to make you even stronger!"
13000603: "By completing Khara Quests in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal sequence, you may even unlock a Hidden Mission, which gives even better rewards! So go out, enjoy exploring Rune-Midgarts, and enjoy the Khara Quest system to its fullest!"
13000701: The great Merman Warrior Putaruta is excited to provide new heroes with supplies for their adventure!
13000702: "By simply logging in, you will receive a small attendance gift. A special treasure awaits diligent adventurers after 7 days of consecutive attendance, and the rewards get better and better the more days you log in!"
14000101: "Crafting is a critical part of Ragnarok Online 2, allowing players to create a variety of items to help in their travels, from food and potions to weapons, armor, and runes! Plus, you can sell them to other players for a profit!"
14000102: "Your Profession (or Job) is chosen during creation, and determines what type of Crafting your character can perform:"
14000103: "Alchemist – Can create health and SP potions, as well as potions that can increase attributes"
14000104: "Artisan – Can create armor for all Magician, Priest, Archer, Thief, and Noel classes, as well as Runes that can be inserted into high-level equipment
14000105: "Blacksmith – Can create weapons for all classes, armor for all Swordsman classes, as well as Socket Drills that will allow Runes to be inserted into equipment."
14000106: "Chef – Can create foods to restore health and SP outside of battle, as well as foods that can grant attribute buffs for up to an hour"
14000107: "Each Job gathers its crafting ingredients in a different way (described in each Job entry), but the crafting process for all Jobs is the same! Open the Crafting window through the Menu or the assigned Hotkey (default: J), and the window below is displayed."
14000109:
"This shows your Job and the current Job Level.
This area allows you to filter your Crafting recipes in a variety of different ways. The upper tabs allow you to switch between recipes you’ve learned, or see the ones you may still want to acquire. The dropdown will allow you to filter the recipes based on the different types of item they will produce, or to just display them all. Finally, the ‘Available List’ checkbox will only allow recipes that can be crafted to be displayed.
This area displays all of the recipes that fulfill the filters set above. The default display is to display all recipes under their category headings.
After selecting a recipe, this area will display the result of the recipe, showing the name and quantity that will be created for each crafting success.
After selecting a recipe, this area displays all of the required components necessary to craft the recipe.
After selecting a recipe, this area displays how much Job experience you will gain by crafting the selected recipe, and the quantity listing will show how many times you can craft the recipe based on the materials you have on hand.
These buttons allow you to actually craft the desired items. ‘Craft All’ will allow you to craft as many iterations of the recipe as you have materials for (based on the Quantity listing above). The ‘Craft’ button will craft a single instance of the selected recipe."
14000111: The Chef’s specialty is in crafting food items that can be used to heal outside of combat or to provide lengthy buffs that can give a player an edge during combat.
14000113: "A Chef can gather ingredients by harvesting them from defeated enemies, shown as a sparkling interaction over the corpse of an enemy with the ‘Cutting’ cursor visible. "
14000114: "If creatures don’t have a unique item that can be harvested, they will often drop a material that can be processed for use later! These are called ‘Processed Materials’."
14000115: "After you've collected your ingredients and your recipe is complete, the delicious food you’ve created will be deposited in your bag to enjoy yourself, or to share with others!"
14000117: "Demeter was once a glorious palace chef. She held cooking skills that enchanted kings around the world. She believed that cooking should be fulfilling for both the body and soul to create happiness!\nAfter endless effort and research, with many happy test subjects, she completed her masterpiece recipe. Unfortunately, the Day of Despair robbed her of the chance to create her ultimate dish."
14000118: """Where do you think the art of cooking ends?\nIf your hands, eyes, and mindset on cooking are honest then I will give you all my knowledge… for you to fulfill my dream of making people happy with cooking.""
14000120: "The Blacksmith specializes in working with metals, creating weapons for all kinds of adventurers across Rune-Midgarts, and making heavy metal armor for Swordsman, Knight, and Warrior classes. They can also produce Socket Drills for adventurers to use, allowing the addition of magical Runes to make their crafted items even stronger."
14000121: "A Blacksmith gathers their ingredients by mining the ores scattered across Rune-Midgarts, shown as a sparkling interaction over a stone with the ‘Mining’ cursor visible. Some locations are more hidden than others, so explore diligently!"
14000122: "Blacksmiths can also make use of the extra materials that defeated creatures drop. These can be processed for use later, and are called ‘Processed Materials’."
14000123: "After you’ve smelted your ores and finished smithing your project, the new item you’ve created will be deposited in your bag. You can begin using it yourself or trade it to friends!"
14000125: The greatest blacksmith who ever lived on the Midgard continent.\nThe same blacksmith who created the Holy Sword Balmung that was used to rip the mantle from Vanaheim and ban Freyja forever. He never fulfilled his lifetime wish to create a weapon worthy of the gods before the Day of Despair.
14000126: "Clank~  Clank~  Clank~\n""Is this the sound of a blacksmith’s hammer? Oh, the memories… I feel my body, soul, and desire blazing in me once again. My wish is to create a weapon of the gods.\nPlease fulfill my wish with your steel grip!"""
14000128: "The Alchemist specializes in harvesting herbs and brewing potions of all different types, from HP and SP to short and long-term buffs for stats. Where Chefs can produce foods which provide an extended benefit, they can only be used outside of combat. An Alchemist’s potions can be used at any time!"
14000129: "An Alchemist gathers their ingredients by harvesting herbs all over Rune-Midgarts, shown as a sparkling interaction over a bush or patch of grass with the ‘Harvest’ cursor visible."
14000130: "Alchemists can also make use of the extra materials that defeated creatures drop. These can be processed for use later, and are called ‘Processed Materials’."
14000131: "After you’ve steeped your herbs and your recipe is complete, the wonderous potion you’ve created will be deposited in your bag to make use of on your own adventures, or you can trade or sell them to your friends!"
14000133: "Juno was a great magical city from before the cataclysm on the Day of Despair, and Honenheim was the 3rd Dean of the prestigious Magic Academy there. He built an academic system for alchemy the likes of which the world had never seen before, nor since. His studies took him to new levels of understanding the world, endless possibilities abounded, but he suddenly disappeared, leaving his achievements behind."
14000134: "The world was shocked, but none more than Honenheim himself! His latest studies dealt with combining the souls of humans and demons. His unfortunate choice of subjects were the feared demon Baphomet, and his own soul."
14000135: "His aim was to fuse Baphomet’s powerful magic into a human body to create a new, more powerful, human race. As he prepared his greatest experiment, everything looked to be correct… but the result was terrible. As his soul was not able to resist fusing to the more powerful demon’s body, his mind left him, and only an unreasoning beast remained, which brutally killed all of his assistants. Once finished, the beast fled into the forest."
14000136: "“I could have succeeded in my alchemy if there had been time to fix my formula…”\n\nHe continued his research in hiding, deep within the forest, and awaited the Day of Despair without anyone knowing his whereabouts."
14000137: """You… don’t seem to have your formula right yet, do you. How about letting me teach you all about alchemy? But I have one condition: \nI want you to finish the alchemy formula where I left off…"""
14000139: "The Artisan is an expert in working with all types of fabrics and leathers, allowing them to create armor for all Magician, Priest, Archer, Thief, and Noel classes. They also specialize in the intricate art of Runemaking, allowing them to craft Runes that can be inserted into Rune Holes in different types of equipment."
14000140: "An Artisan gathers their ingredients by harvesting them from defeated enemies, shown as a sparkling interaction over the corpse of an enemy with the ‘Cutting’ cursor visible."
14000141: "If creatures don’t have a unique item that can be harvested, they will often drop a material that can be processed for use later! These are called ‘Processed Materials’."
14000142: "When you’ve finished weaving your new garments, your new creation will be deposited in your bag to wear yourself, or you can trade or sell it to your friends!"
14000144: "Veriel was the top artisan of the continent. His future had no obstacles in the way to success. But Gevril, another artisan who was jealous of Veriel’s success, plotted a terrible but effective plan: to cut off Veriel’s hands.\n\nGevril planned an accident and Veriel lost both of his hands, and with them his destiny to be the greatest artisan of the age."
14000145: "Veriel’s life lost all meaning, and he succumbed to despair and alcoholism. Eventually, Veriel discovered Gevril’s plot and set about to claim his terrible vengeance. Veriel was overcome with fury and tracked down Gevril, killing him with a dagger he held between his teeth."
14000146: "Before he could feel any sense of exultation or justice, however, the world was sundered and set aflame. The Day of Despair spared no one…"
14000147: """Whoo… whoo… whooo… Hehehe… These delicate hands are of an artisan!\nI’m green with envy!\nThose two hands… Give me your hands! Now!"""
14000201: "Monsters throughout Rune-Midgarts may drop magical Cards imbued with their powers. By equipping this Card, this power becomes yours to wield! All adventurers start with 1 Card slot, unlocking additional slots every 10 levels, with a maximum of 5 slots at level 40."
14000203: Card Set: The cards of the 4 Beauties set.
14000204: "There are many cards to collect and some even offer additional bonuses if you manage to collect the entire set! Try and complete your Card collection, and get them all!"
14000301: "Refinement is one of the ways that adventurers in Rune-Midgarts can improve their equipment, and give them an edge before diving back into a difficult dungeon. Refinement is a process in which special items are used to increase the properties of an existing item.\n\nRefinement is divided into distinct categories, each of which deals with empowering a particular category of items: Equipment, Honing, and Cards."
14000303: "Equipment Refinement deals with direct upgrades to your Weapons and Armor, and requires Refinement Stones."
14000305: "Honing allows you to apply a specific style of upgrade, with random results, to your Weapons and Armor by applying Honing Polishes."
14000307: Reinforcement gives you the ability to increase the power of Cards through the use of Card Enhance Stones.
14000311: "Equipment refinement can be done by anyone! To begin, open the Refinement window via the menu, or look for refinement services offered by player vendors."
14000312: "There are 20 levels of refinement which are denoted by a + symbol next to your equipment’s name. Refining armor will add to its Defense, while refining weapons will increase Physical or Magical Damage.\n\nRefinement requires refinement stones or powders, the most basic and widely available is called Polinium. To increase your chances of success, you may also add Blessing Powders to the mix. If you’re feeling particularly lucky, Lucky Powders can raise your refinement level by up to 3 in a single attempt if successful! These rare items are available from the Kafra Shop or by participating in events."
14000313: "But be careful, because Refinement does have a chance to fail! Failure can have three potential outcomes."
14000315: "Your equipment could break and be lost forever. However, you can protect against this by using the special Infinium stone when you refine. Be sure to bring some along! Remember, it’s better to be safe than sorry!\nYour equipment could decrease in level. If your item is less than +10, it will fall by 1 level. If your equipment is greater than +10, then it will fall all the way down to +10 once again.\nYour equipment could stay the same level. This means that all of your materials are lost, but at least your equipment remains!"
14000316: "If you ever happen across a Master Refiner, you’re in luck! These players can be recognized by the Holgren’s Gold Hammer accessory obtained via the weekly ranking rewards. When this item is equipped, players who use their services can expect increased chances to raise multiple levels and increased protection against your item decreasing in level.\n\nLast but not least, you may occasionally stumble across Immediate Refine Stones. These will refine your equipment to the designated level, regardless of what level the equipment started from. Isn’t that super convenient? These extremely rare and powerful items are rewards for War of Emperium Castle and Fortress holders or obtained from events."
14000321: The Honing process imbues your equipment with a variety of powerful stats. Equipment that can be honed will marked as being “Honing Available” when you read the item’s tooltip.
14000322: "To begin the Honing process, you will need Honing Polishes. These polishes come in a wide variety of affected stats, and range from 10-100% success rate of receiving that particular stat as one of your bonuses. The Honing Polishes from 10% to 50% are sold by the Kafra Service vendors, but rarer ones are harder to come by. Note that Attack Power and Magic Power Honing Polishes can only be used on weapons, and Defense Honing Polishes can only be used on Armor."
14000323: "There are two ways to start Honing: The first is by opening the Honing window located under Menu. The second is to use the services of another player, if they have set up a personal shop to do so. In the Honing window, place the equipment you wish to hone in the top box (1) and place your Honing Polish into the bottom left box (2). In the bottom right box (3), you can add Honing Oils if you have them to try and improve your results, but this is completely optional. If you have enough zeny for the service fee, you can click Start Honing and see your results!\n\nThe rarity of your Equipment will determine how many bonuses you can receive:"
14000325: "After honing, your equipment will gain a prefix, which determine the stats of the first two bonuses. The type of Honing Polish and its success rate determines the third bonus. If your equipment can have the fourth and fifth bonuses, they will be randomly generated.\n\nIf you do not like the stats that have been generated, there are two ways to change them:"
14000327: "This item can be applied to your equipment to remove all Honing bonuses and reset your item’s prefix.\n\nThis item can be used to replace an existing bonus with a random new one. However, you cannot use these on the first two bonuses as those are determined by your item prefix."
14000328: "Each piece of equipment has a range of bonuses it can provide. Factors that determine this range includes an item’s level, the number of stars it has, the type of equipment, and the application of honing oils. There are even back accessories obtained from ranking rewards that can improve the range of your honing bonuses, so be on the lookout for these Master Honers and use their services to make your strongest gear!"
14000331: "Reinforcement is one of the ways that Cards can be upgraded, and is the process used to improve the power of a Card."
14000332: "Through the services of the Card Master, Cards can be further Reinforced to draw out more power by using ""Card Enhance Stones"", up to a maximum of +10. This is a difficult and volatile process that may even destroy the card itself, but the results are definitely worth it! To protect yourself when trying to Reinforce your Cards, make sure to use Card Coating Paper to protect your Card, or maybe use Cardfinium to reduce the chances of failure and protect your Card at the same time!\n\nKeep in mind, a Card that has been Reinforced will lose its bonus if you attempt to Combine it, so please make sure you Combine cards before Reinforcing them!"
14000401: "Fusion is one of the ways that adventurers in Rune-Midgarts can alter and improve their equipment, and involves combining (or fusing!) two items together to create something new.\n\nFusion is divided into distinct categories, each dealing with different types of item fusion: Cosmetic Items, Cards, Auras, and Transmogrification."
14000403: "Cosmetic Fusion allows an adventurer to combine two Costume items together, using Cosmetic Fusion Tablets and Charms, to create a new item."
14000405: "Card Combination allows an adventurer to merge 5 cards together, using a Synthesis Stone, for a chance to create an improved version of a card - or even a totally different card."
14000407: "Aura Fusion allows an adventurer to combine an Aura with a powerful piece of Chest Armor, granting you a super cool effect when you wear it."
14000409: Transmogrification allows an adventurer to combine the appearance of one piece of equipment with the abilities and stats of another.
14000411: "Tired of the same wardrobe? Give yourself a makeover with the Cosmetic Fusion system! Combine any two costumes together and get a new one, it’s that easy!"
14000412: "First, you will need a Cosmetic Fusion Tablet. These can be purchased from the Kafra Shop or earned as part of special event rewards. Once activated, you will see five slots: the top row allows you to attach up to three Charms (explained below), while the lower two are the costumes you will be fusing together.\n\nYou don’t have to use charms, but they have powerful magic that you’ll want to take advantage of. You can purchase most of them from the Kafra Shop."
14000414:
Appearance Fusion Charm



Rune Fusion Charm








Magic Fusion Charm






Head Fusion Charm


Face Fusion Charm


Lower Face Fusion Charm

Top Fusion Charm


Back Fusion Charm
14000415:
"This charm allows you to retain the costume selected, but does not transfer over things like color dyes. For example, use this charm to make sure your Octopus Head stays an Octopus Head after fusion.

This charm allows you to preserve your existing runes and runeholes in one costume item. When used with an Appearance Fusion Charm, the runes that will be preserved will be the same as the costume that you select to preserve the appearance of. Existing runes will be transferred over. You do not need to have runeholes punched or filled in the costume to have the runeholes transfer. This charm provides a bonus chance to receive additional runeholes.

This charm allows you to use two normal costume items to have a chance at a Cheny item. Cheny cosmetic items, such as Kafra Ruby or Swag, cannot be used in normal fusion. This charm increases the chance that you will receive one of these magic costume items in fusion. This charm cannot be combined with other charms and is only available through the Cheny Shop.

This charm ensures that your fusion result will be a costume that can be equipped on the hat slot.

This charm ensures that your fusion result will be a costume that can be equipped on the middle face slot.

This charm ensures that your fusion result will be a costume that can be equipped on the lower face (mouth) slot.

This charm ensures that your fusion result will be a costume that can be equipped on the body slot.

This charm ensures that your fusion result will be a costume that can be equipped on the back accessory slot."
14000421: "Combination is one of the ways that Cards can be upgraded, and is the process used to combine multiple Cards into a single Card."
14000422: "Through the services of the Card Master, you can combine 5 different cards with a Synthesis Stone for a chance to create ""Plus"" versions of the card for new stats or even create cards of a higher rarity. The Kafra Corporation has even created a special ""Card Designated Synthesis"" tool that has the ability to manipulate and predict the outcome of your combination as well as protect one of the cards in case of failure. This tool can be purchased in the Kafra Shop!\n\nKeep in mind, a Card that has been Reinforced will lose its bonus if you attempt to Combine it, so please make sure you Combine cards before Reinforcing them!"
14000431: Let’s get down to business. Do you want the swiftness of a coursing river? Perhaps the strength of a raging fire? Or are you feeling mysterious like the dark side of the moon?\n\nWell then find the Mysterious Leprechaun in Prontera! He can enchant your chest armor with an aura. Keep in mind that the chest armor must be Master Level and Epic tier.
14000432: "First you will need to exchange Piece of Loki’s Aura with the Loki Merchants to obtain an aura of your choice, or try your luck and get a random aura from the Black Magic Aura item from Cheny. If you don’t like the aura you obtained, you can use a Magic Wrapper on it to receive another one.\n\nOnce an aura is applied, it cannot be removed unless you use it as a Transmogrification material. Keeping that in mind, you will want to use an Aura as the final step to completing your style!"
14000441: "Are you a priest that always feels like a tank because your party cannot keep enemies away from you, no matter how much you yell at them? Why not look the part and put on some heavy armor to intimidate your opponents? Let us take a look at the Transmogrification system!"
14000442: "Through powerful illusion magic, The Mysterious Leprechaun is able to replace the appearance of one equipment onto another of the same type. Of course, there is a price to pay for beauty. No, not your soul, we don’t want to know where that has been. Having been robbed of his pot of gold, the Mysterious Leprechaun wants your zeny and diamonds! Find him in Prontera and let us begin!"
14000443: Here are a few tips to keep in mind!
14000445:
"The Target item will determine the stats of your fusion result. It will keep any runes, honing, and refinements already applied to it.
The Appearance item determines the look of the fusion result. However, any dyes applied to the Appearance item will not be carried over. You will be able to dye the fusion result, provided that the original appearance item can be dyed.
If applicable, the Appearance item determines any gender or race restrictions.
Any existing Auras will be lost after Transmogrification.
The Appearance item is consumed in the process, so make sure to remove any valuable runes before beginning!"
14000501: "Runes are small stones created by Artisans and a handful of others to hold magical power, and with some work, these Runes can work for you, too! "
14000502: "You may have noticed that some pieces of equipment contain Runeholes. Once unlocked by an appropriate Runehole Puncher, you can equip Runes to strengthen your equipment further.\nAll of the standard Runehole Punchers can be crafted by Blacksmiths, so make sure you have at least one good Blacksmith friend! The Super Puncher and Rune Slot Accessory Puncher are specialized punchers that work on Costumes and Accessories, and can be purchased in the Kafra Shop."
14000504:
Cast Iron Runehole Puncher

Drill Runehole Puncher

Screw Runehole Puncher

Spark Runehole Puncher

Rocket Runehole Puncher

Super Puncher

Rune Slot Accessory Puncher
14000505:
"Unlocks runeholes on Weapons and Armor, level 29 and below.
Unlocks runeholes on Weapon and Armor, level 34 and below.
Unlocks runeholes on Weapon and Armor, level 39 and below.
Unlocks runeholes on Weapon and Armor, level 44 and below.
Unlocks runeholes on Weapon and Armor, level 50 and above.
Unlocks runeholes on Decoration Costumes

Unlocks runeholes on Accessories"
14000506: Each type of runehole can equip specific types of runes:
14000508: "Can equip Artisan crafted runes, Enhanced Radiant Runes, and Bind Runes up to +50, which provide bonuses to specific primary stats"
14000510: Can equip Chung Lim Sa runes which provide bonuses to PVP stats
14000512: "Can equip Artisan crafted runes, Enhanced Radiant Runes, Bind Runes up to +80, and Chung Lim Sa runes"
14000514: Can equip Blueseed Runes which provide bonuses to all primary stats
14000516: Can equip Greenseed Runes which provide unique passive abilities
14000518: Can equip Redseed Runes which provide bonuses to specific secondary stats
14000520: "Can equip any of Blueseed, Greenseed, or Redseed Runes"
14000522:
"Artisan Crafted Runes

Enhanced Radiant Runes

Chung Lim Sa Runes

Bind Runes



Blueseed, Redseed Runes
Greenseed Runes"
14000523:
These can be created by the Artisan Job Profession. They require crystals obtained by disenchanting rare quality equipment.
These are created by using Enhancement Elixirs on Radiant Runes crafted by Artisans. Enhancement Elixirs can be purchased from the Kafra Shop or by opening Pandora’s Box.
These can be obtained by competing in the Jehoon Training Grounds PVP mode.
Speak with the Rune Merchant NPCs located in Prontera to exchange materials for these runes. These materials are rewarded for completing daily quests from the Wanted List Boards in Morroc.
These runes may drop from monsters located in the Fallen Fortress map.
These runes are obtained by participating in the Chaos Dungeon raid.
14000524: "Please note that once equipped, you will need a Rune Remover to unlink the rune from your equipment. You can also override existing runes simply by equipping a new one over the slot, but be warned that this will permanently destroy the old one."
15000101: "Kafra Points are the premier currency used by the Kafra Corporation in Ragnarok Online 2! These points are purchased with real money, from wherever you may be sitting right now."
15000103: "Depending on exactly how you’re reaching Rune-Midgarts, there are a few different ways to go about purchasing and receiving your Kafra Points."
15000105: "Please log into the service (either Facebook or Steam) directly, launch the game client, and navigate the in-game options in the Kafra Shop to make your purchases."
15000107: "Log into your WarpPortal account, choose the ‘Power-UP’ option, then follow the directions on how to convert WarpPortal Points into Kafra Points!"
15000109:
"First time orders for Paypal or Credit Card will be subject to an internal review process.

During this time, your initial transaction will not be charged until the process is completed and notified by the team. While waiting for the result from the review process, we highly recommend alternative purchase options based on your region as it requires no wait time or internal review process.
